full_judgment: 2. The facts of the case are, that the 4 petitioners Abu Taiyab Mia, Md. Joynal Abedin, Fakhrul Islam and Mst. Anwara Begum as Plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 230 of 1983 on 7.12.83 before the 2nd Court of Munsif, Feni against the 2 opposite parties and others and defendants for declaration of title and confirmation of possession in respect of 0.23 acre of land out of 0.24 acres as shown in the Ka schedule of the plaint appertaining to plot No. 3 of CS khatian No. 253 of mouza Jagthpur, Upazila Dagan Bhuiyan, District Feni and for declaration of title and for khas possession in the remaining 0.01 acre of land of the said plot No. 3 as shown in the schedule Kha to the plaint. The plaintiff-petitioner by an application dated 7.12.83 under Order 39 rules 1 and 2 prayed for temporary injunction against defendant Nos. 2 and 3 of the suit restraining them from dispossessing the plaintiff from Ka schedule land. The learned Munsif by his order dated 7.12.83 granted ad interim injunction restraining the said defendant Nos. 2 and 3 from dispossessing the plaintiff from the said 0.23 acre of land but after hearing both the parties the learned Munsif rejected the prayer for temporary injunction by his order dated 21.3.84. Against the aforesaid order dated 21.3.84 passed by the learned Munsif the plaintiff-petitioners preferred Misc. Appeal No. 64 of 1984 before the learned District Judge, Noakhali which was later transferred to the District Judge, Feni and was re-numbered as Misc. Appeal No. 24 of 1985. The said appeal was heard by the learned Subordinate Judge, Feni who dismissed the appeal by his judgment and order dated 27.4.85. Against the order dated 27.4.85 passed by the learned Subordinate Judge the plaintiff-petitioners preferred a revisional application under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure and a learned single Judge of this Court of the Comilla Bench on 20.5.85 issued Rule in Civil Revision No. 154 of 1985 and after hearing both the parties a learned Single Judge of this Court on 11.12.85 sitting at the then Comilla Bench disposed of the Rule observing that while issuing the Rule on 20.5.85 this Court directed the parties to maintain status quo in respect of the suit land till the disposal of the Rule, that no argument has been advanced that this order is working to the prejudice of any party and that the parties are directed to maintain status quo in respect of the suit land till the disposal of Title Suit No. 230 of 1983 pending in the 2nd Court of Munsif, Feni subject to the condition that the opposite parties shall be at liberty to undertake repairs of the structures on the suit land.
